Hi Alex — apologies for the slight delay. Below is the operational breakdown and the artifacts we can provide. I copied Lauren to coordinate dates.

1) Pre-handover (export window)
- We will create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of the tenant datastore and KV cache. Snapshot is exported directly to a pre-authorized S3 bucket you provide.
- Encryption: exported objects are encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (we will perform a one-time key-wrap for transfer). You must provide ARN and IAM principal for write.
- We will freeze writes and reroute a short maintenance window (usually 30–60 minutes) to ensure snapshot consistency.

2) Evidence package we supply at export time
- SHA256 manifest of exported object list
- Operational log of commands run and timestamps (redacted ops hostnames as needed)
- Snapshot manifest + file sizes and object counts
- Signed PDF attestation (GPG and org-signed) with deletion commitment schedule

3) Post-acceptance deletion path
- Once you confirm receipt and integrity of exported snapshot we will begin the irreversible deletion workflow.
- Default: 30-day soft-hold (snapshots and tape/backups marked for deletion) then permanent purge.
- For regulated customers we can set the soft-hold to 7 days provided DocuSign acceptance and an SLA amendment.

4) Backups and retained artifacts
- Short-term backups (hot backups) are removed during the purge. Long-term disaster recovery backups: we will enumerate any copies and include them in attestation.
- If there are archived off-site copies tied to the tenant we will list them and include removal dates.

5) KMS / Key rotation
- As part of the handover we recommend rotating customer keys after export. Redwood will rotate any internal keys touching tenant material. Keys used for export will be recorded in the manifest.

6) Evidence and audit readiness
- We can produce a signed attestation with a manifest and timeline. We also support a short SOC2 addendum if your auditors require it.

I've attached our internal checklist (tenant_teardown_checklist.pdf) — it includes the step-by-step ops commands, required IAM roles, and a sample DocuSign acceptance form.

Next steps: Lauren, can you propose two available maintenance windows before Dec 7? Alex — please share S3 bucket ARN and the IAM principal.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
